import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 8,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.size': 3,
    'ytick.major.size': 3,
})

steps = [500, 1000, 1500, 2000]
entropy = [0.702, 0.800, 0.608, 0.304]
tof = [0.000, 0.006, 0.000, 0.000]

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.5), dpi=300)

color_ent = '#2166ac'
color_tof = '#b2182b'

ax1.plot(steps, entropy, color=color_ent, marker='o', markersize=4,
         linewidth=1.8, linestyle='-', label='Generation Entropy', zorder=5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Training Step', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_ylabel('Generation Entropy', color=color_ent, fontsize=8)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_ent, labelsize=7)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1.0)
ax1.set_xlim(350, 2150)
ax1.set_xticks(steps)
ax1.grid(False)

ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(steps, tof, color=color_tof, marker='s', markersize=4,
         linewidth=1.8, linestyle='--', label='True-positive Flip Rate (ToF)', zorder=5)
ax2.set_ylabel('True-positive Flip Rate (ToF)', color=color_tof, fontsize=8)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_tof, labelsize=7)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 0.01)
ax2.grid(False)

# Vertical annotation lines
ax1.axvline(x=500, color='#666666', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='-', alpha=0.7, zorder=2)
ax1.axvline(x=1840, color='#666666', linewidth=0.8, linestyle=':', alpha=0.7, zorder=2)

# Text annotations
ax1.annotate('Behavioral death\n(ToF = 0)', xy=(500, 0.92), fontsize=6.5,
             ha='left', va='top', color='#444444',
             xytext=(520, 0.95))

ax1.annotate('Entropy\ncollapse', xy=(1840, 0.92), fontsize=6.5,
             ha='right', va='top', color='#444444',
             xytext=(1820, 0.95))

# Double-headed arrow for the lag
arrow_y = 0.08
ax1.annotate('', xy=(500, arrow_y), xytext=(1840, arrow_y),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#444444', lw=1.2))
ax1.text((500 + 1840) / 2, arrow_y + 0.04, '1,300-step lag',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6.5, color='#444444', style='italic')

# Combined legend
lines1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper right',
           fontsize=6, frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor='#cccccc',
           framealpha=0.95)

plt.tight_layout()

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-3/projects/contrastive_entrain_calib/artifacts/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_probe_trap.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.02)
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_probe_trap.png', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.02, dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('Done.')
